title: Post-Discharge Follow-Up and Medication Reconciliation Figures in Care Management
content:
After a member of Care Management is discharged from hospital, the tier fixes three figures: the calendar days after the discharge within which the care team follows up, the contact mode that follow-up must use, and the calendar days after the discharge by which medications are reconciled.

| Care Management tier | Follow-up within (calendar days after discharge) | Contact mode required for the follow-up | Medications reconciled by (calendar days after discharge) |
|---|---|---|---|
| Healthy Living Support | 7 | Phone | 0 |
| Care Coordination Level 1 | 7 | Phone | 30 |
| Care Coordination Level 2 | 3 | Phone | 30 |
| Maternal Care Management | 3 | Phone | 30 |
| Complex Case Management | 2 | In person | 30 |
| Health Home Services | 3 | Phone | 30 |
| LTSS Service Coordination | 2 | In person | 30 |

A 0 in the medication column means medication reconciliation is not done in that tier; it applies to Healthy Living Support only.

## Worked comparison (hypothetical discharge on 12 May)

| Tier | Follow-up due by | Mode | Medications reconciled by |
|---|---|---|---|
| Complex Case Management | 14 May | In person | 11 June |
| Health Home Services | 15 May | Phone | 11 June |
| Care Coordination Level 1 | 19 May | Phone | 11 June |
| Healthy Living Support | 19 May | Phone | not done |

The two tiers with a 2-day follow-up, Complex Case Management and LTSS Service Coordination, are also the two whose follow-up must be in person; a phone call does not meet their required mode.
